attributes.name: Raytheon Company
attributes.blurb: Defense contractor; merged with UTC. Surviving company exists as a subsidiary of the renamed UTC, company, Raytheon Technologies
attributes.summary:
Raytheon is a major American defense contractor that specializes in defense and homeland security technology. As the world’s largest producer of guided missiles, Raytheon specializes in manufacturing defense systems and defense electronics. 

A member of the defense electronic industry, Raytheon is most active lobbying on defense, homeland security and federal budget appropriation issues.

attributes.name: RTX
attributes.summary: Publicly-traded defense and aerospace contractor, the result of mergers by UTC and Raytheon and the spin-offs of Otis Worldwide and Carrier

attributes.name: The Cipher Brief
attributes.blurb: Developer of a digital media platform designed to provide the latest security news & relevant analysis.
attributes.summary: Backed by venture capital. The company's platform operates an online news service application that covers national and global security for the business audience, enabling companies to foster dialogue on what events mean for businesses and organizations around the world and thereby anticipate and navigate the complex and unstable global environment.
